scope: Deterministic development playground for the 11-channel ionic operator at imposed V and imposed calcium bridge. Recurrent physical gate targets, individual signed currents and evaluators; no training, new native simulation, membrane/axial/synapse replacement or emergent-spike validation.

quality.normalization: For each trajectory/channel S=max(max_t abs(I_reference),1e-7 mA/cm2). Charge errors divided by duration*S, not near-zero signed target charge. Report absolute errors and peak-relative charge diagnostics as well. No averaging across regimes to waive a failed critical gate.
quality.event_support: Transient timing evaluated only when reference peak-baseline contrast >=25% of S, peak >=10*floor, and peak is internal to the window. Other cases explicitly not_evaluable; amplitude/current gates still apply. Onset/offset use 10% of reference transient amplitude. Multi-event morphology needs dedicated matching in closed-loop stage.

cost_contract.primary_work: 80 causal ionic ticks at dt0.1ms, per-site explicit state, all 11 currents, conductances and pre-Ca source observable, Ca bridge supplied identically
cost_contract.baseline: competitive exact formula and analytic LUT, same readout and compilation

training_draft.coverage_contrast: fit versus fit+fit_extra, same update budget; preserve family sampling exposure counters
training_draft.status: Draft only; training requires Task38 architecture/optimizer parity and GPU preflight, including all source and numerical checks.

limitations: Synthetic imposed paths are controlled stress, not a physiological frequency distribution. Voltage pulse counts are not emergent spikes. Channel activation boundaries are not validated dynamical bifurcations. Rare-case coverage and compute may matter; no abstract model is judged or trained. Fully coupled Ca/V, burst/ISI, near-bifurcation sensitivity and qualitative model-behavior gates remain required at Task40/41; no promotion using this isolated suite alone.
